subject: Neighborhood Heavy Trucking Restrictions
overview: The Public Works and Facilities Committee met to discuss Resolution 25-095 regarding strategies to limit heavy commercial trucking on residential streets. The committee voted to keep the resolution in committee and refer a proposed action plan to the Traffic Commission and Department of Public Works.

items.title: Resolution to Reduce Heavy Trucking on Neighborhood Streets
items.summary: The committee reviewed state regulations, engineering study requirements, and municipal options for restricting heavy commercial vehicle traffic on residential cut-through streets. The committee voted to keep the paper in committee and refer the chair's proposed action plan to the Department of Public Works and Traffic Commission for a response by January 31.
